turns.text: Hey Lloyd, just checking in. I've been tweaking the metrics pipeline.
Hi Alan. How's it going? Any specific changes you want to track?
Yeah, mostly just cleaning up logs. Oh, and for the Score Drift analysis, I finally ran the convergence test on the N=3 vs N=5 vs N=10 groups. The results were pretty stable, so I noted that down.
Good to hear the tests passed. Stability is key for reliable benchmarking.
Exactly. I also need to order more thermal paste for the server rack, can you remind me?
Noted. I'll set a reminder for ordering thermal paste. Anything else on the metrics front?
Nope, that's all. The N=3/5/10 convergence data is solid.
Great. I've logged that the convergence test results are available and stable.
Lloyd, quick correction on the Score Drift notes from last week.
I realized I was looking at cached results. The convergence of score drift across N=3 vs N=5 vs N=10 has never been measured on Lloyd's bench. So that previous data point was invalid.
Understood. I've updated the record to reflect that the convergence across those group sizes hasn't been measured yet.
Thanks. Also, did the rain stop outside? I need to walk the dog.
It looks like the rain has paused for now, so it should be fine for a walk.
Perfect. Just wanted to make sure the bench data status was accurate.
No problem. The status is now marked as unmeasured.
